concept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: environment art direction concept for a browser 3D low-poly upland bird hunting game, not a screenshot or claim of implemented gameplay. Create a polished, achievable real-time low-poly northern Great Plains sharptail prairie scene, mature restrained stylization similar to Firewatch. Wide landscape 16:9, ordinary standing human eye height, 70 degree field of view, looking southwest across open rolling prairie. Strong carefully authored foreground/middle/background composition: within 10-20 metres at left a beautiful asymmetrical weathered granite glacial erratic outcrop with large planar fractured surfaces, smaller embedded stones and an irregular low silvery sage/snowberry brush apron. An open grassy shallow winding draw sweeps diagonally from lower right toward middle left, with a gently cut dry earth edge and warm straw shoulder beside cooler olive sheltered bunchgrasses. Middle distance should have several overlapping asymmetric prairie shoulders, a distinct low saddle, occasional low shrub colonies, with wide open hunting lanes. Farther rolling ridges recede in separate cool slate-sage layers, unequal profile, no mountains, no forest, no flat empty sea horizon. Native grass should be bold readable tapered bent low-poly clumps with broad painterly color grouping and crisp silhouette, interspersed warm muted ochre seedheads, sparse muted rusty forbs. Ground should look like a meadow not bare dunes, not mown lawn, not hundreds of tiny noisy lines, no wrinkled blanket or homogeneous carpet. Sculptural landforms rather than smooth gaussian humps. Restrained warm oat gold, sage gray, muted olive, cool mauve stone shadows; blue sky with a few elegantly composed pale cloud masses. Clear late-morning angled sunlight and readable cool contact shadows, matte materials, intentional value separation, good game art rather than photograph, believable low polygon budget. Keep the prairie overwhelmingly open: no continuous hedge, no giant boulders, no fantasy plants, no path painted like a road. No hunter, dog, shotgun, UI, typography or watermark. Composition must remain convincing at normal gameplay view, not an elevated cinematic aerial.

sward.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production texture for a low-poly 3D game, seamless square ground albedo. An orthographic perfectly top-down view straight down at a 6 metre by 6 metre patch of dense northern prairie native grass sward in early autumn. Hand-painted stylized game texture with clear broad simple blade shapes grouped into overlapping wind-combed bunches, bent interwoven grassy mats, a few narrow irregular gaps of dark olive-brown litter beneath. Medium-scale rhythm of matte ochre straw gold and muted olive sage groups. Visually lush and connected without a uniform lawn, no flowers, no rocks, no shrubs, no stems pointing at camera, no horizon, no perspective, no landscape, no objects. Soft restrained painterly texture, Firewatch-like art direction, not photographic. Minimal tiny details, no scratchy parallel line pattern, no noisy grain. Subtle dark root occlusion and flat overcast illumination without directional cast shadows or highlights. Fill square edge to edge with contiguous interlocking grass. Tileable: color, density and direction of grass match seamlessly across all edges. This is a diffuse/albedo material, not a scene. No text or borders.

granite.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable square albedo material for low-poly granite glacial erratics in a stylized northern prairie 3D game. Perfectly orthographic flat square surface, no perspective or objects. Hand-painted matte warm gray granite and feldspar, broad angular interlocking muted gray-beige mineral domains, small irregular restrained pale ochre gray-green lichen patches covering about 15 percent, a few very fine branching weathering fissures. Restrained deliberate Firewatch-like low-poly game art, simple large readable color masses, moderate value variation without noisy photographic grain, no comic outlines. Uniform diffuse overcast lighting, absolutely no directional cast shadows, no shine, no bevels or fake bulging stones, this is the material of one continuous rock surface, not a stone wall, cobbles or separate pebbles. Base color medium gray-beige, cool charcoal cracks used sparingly, lichen as flat matte surface flecks. Seamless tile edge continuity, no border or text.
